title: How a Blender Works in 60 Seconds 🍓🌀 #shorts
description:
A blender is a fast motor plus a few angled blades. The blades spin thousands of times a minute, create a whirlpool that pulls food down into them, and the jar's shape keeps everything tumbling back for another cut. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#blender #smoothie #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: The blades in a high-speed blender can spin over *20,000 times* every minute.

steps.label: Motor
steps.text: An electric *motor* in the base turns a toothed *coupling* that locks into the jar.

steps.label: Blades
steps.text: The coupling spins a set of angled *blades*. Some tilt up, some tilt down, to hit food at *every level*.

steps.label: Vortex
steps.text: That spin whips the liquid into a *vortex*, a whirlpool that pulls food *down* into the blades.

steps.label: Circulation
steps.text: Food gets flung *outward*, climbs the walls, and falls back to the center to be *cut again*.

steps.label: Jar shape
steps.text: Ribs or square corners in the jar *break the swirl*, so food tumbles instead of just spinning in place.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Spin, pull, *blend*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
